title: MOVE / KEEP
action: Record movement, release, retain the samples and resulting seed.
material_fact: Rounded positions, orientations and elapsed times are hashed and reduced to a seed from 0 to 999.

evidence.claim: A fixed SHA-256-based encoding and reduction derives one of 1000 seeds; many gestures can share a seed.
An adequate recording yields a retained seed; visible traces accompany capture.

primary.author: Vilém Flusser
primary.operation: Follow how a gesture becomes an input to an apparatus with prescribed possibilities.

counterpoint.author: Francis Ponge
counterpoint.operation: Keep the sphere and traces in view while describing the reduction.

refusal: Do not claim a gesture is certified true randomness.
A possible seed collision is not an observed pair of gestures.
The seed does not explain the person's intention.
